title: Pure-tensor formula for the section tensor map
statement: Let f:U → X be a morphism of schemes. Put A=f_*O_U, ρ:O_X → A its structure map, IA=f⁻¹A, r₀:f⁻¹O_X → O_U its adjoint structure map, and t₀=f⁻¹ρ. Let B be a commutative-ring sheaf on U, b:O_U → B and t:IA → B making a pushout of r₀ and t₀. For an open V of X put W=f⁻¹V, D=Γ(X,V), C=Γ(U,W), and δ=t_W ∘ η_{A,V}:C → B(W). For the constructed q of [stage3-affine-pushout-ring-section-map], q(c tensor d)=b_W(c)δ(d).

source.place: Tag 01SB affine reduction; Tags 01I9, 01IA and 01HV for affine pullback sections

proof.text: The inl_desc and inr_desc equations give q(c tensor 1)=b_W(c) and q(1 tensor d)=δ(d). The tensor ring multiplication gives (c tensor 1)(1 tensor d)=c tensor d. Multiplicativity of q proves the formula.
